items.description: C5+ reformate yield (vol% of naphtha feed) at product RON for commercial reforming processes; columns are yield and product research octane number
items.unit: vol% C5+ of naphtha feed; RON
items.note: Table 24.6 (p. 663) 'Feedstock and Product Data for the Platforming Process': feed API 59.0, 197-233 F, paraffins 69 / naphthenes 21 / aromatics 10 % v/v; 'Research octane number 100 100 100'; 'Composition,% v/v C5+ 70 78 82' at 295, 123, 49 psi. Table 24.7 (p. 664) Powerforming: feed paraffins 57 / naphthenes 30 / aromatics 13; 'Research octane number 99 101'; 'C5+ 79 79'. Yield falls with octane and with feed paraffin content; lower pressure and continuous regeneration raise it. Textbook is Speight, not Gary and Handwerk (not found).

items.description: Semi-regenerative reformer reformate yield and product RON (weight basis)
items.note: 'The main process parameters of reforming units operation over semi-regenerative type are the following: pressure — from 1.3 up to 3.0 MPa; temperature — from 480 up to 530o C; octane number (RON) — from 94 up to 100; reformate yield — from 80 up to 88 wt. %.' Vendor page; wt basis (reformate is denser than naphtha, so vol% is lower than wt% would suggest in volume terms).
